The '''TIE/br boarding shuttle''', also known as the '''TIE Boarding Craft''' or '''Imperial boarding craft''', was a variant of the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]] used for boarding and troop [[Transport/Legends|transportation]] and as a [[Boarding craft/Legends|boarding craft]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:RopeLaddersAreSuperHighTech-MSW53.png|thumb|left|A [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]]/br participates in a kidnapping mission on [[Shiva IV]].]]
The [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]]/br boarding shuttle had an enlarged, hollow secondary pod with clamps and a hull-cutter. The primary pod was also large enough to be capable of retrieving escape pods. Although they generally were in the same design basis as the TIE/sa bomber, some had the pods inverted.<ref name="The Constancia Affair" />

It was used to deliver small [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] boarding parties onto captured or disabled ships when larger vessels such as the [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class assault shuttle]] were not appropriate for the task. Unlike most craft in the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]], the boarding craft was equipped with landing gear and was able to land on a hangar deck instead of in an overhead launch rack. Passengers could then disembark via a boarding ramp. It could also retrieve any life pods if an S.O.S. signal was transmitting.<ref name="The Constancia Affair" />

In some cases, such as requiring a quick air extraction, the TIE/br was also equipped with a droplift ladder.<ref name="The Last Gift of Alderaan">[[Star Wars (1977) 53|''Star Wars'' (1977) 53]]</ref>

==History==
[[File:BoardingCraft356-TCA.png|thumb|left|A hijacked boarding craft.]]
A TIE/br was used by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in the [[Battle of Tatooine (Galactic Civil War)|capture]] of [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia's]] [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]], [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="ICS">''[[Star Wars: Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> A TIE/br designated [[boarding craft 356]] was hijacked by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Sharlee]] after infiltrating and taking out its crew by using a life pod and SOS signal, in an attempt to ensure the planet of [[Constancia/Legends|Constancia]] remained free from Imperial involvement and for Luke to deliver a message to the planet.<ref name="The Constancia Affair" /> A TIE Boarding Craft was also utilized by the [[T'Syriél]] members of the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]] helmed by the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] warlord, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Bentilais san Sk'ar]], to capture [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Aron Peacebringer]] on [[Shiva IV]].<ref name="The Last Gift of Alderaan" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tieboardingcraft.jpg|thumb|right|150px|TIE boarding craft concept art]]
This ship was designed for the very [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|first]] ''[[Star Wars]]'' film, but the exterior model would not make it into any scenes. The design would be resurrected for [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''The Empire Strikes Back'']] as the TIE bomber and the [[TIE/sh VIP shuttle|TIE shuttle]]. Likewise, the TIE/sa bomber itself also featured a similar usage to the TIE boarding craft in ''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron III: Rebel Strike]]'', in the [[Raid at Bakura]] mission, as Wedge Antilles, if the player gets a Silver Medal or better, will have to hijack a TIE bomber in order to rescue Hobbie after he was shot down on Bakura.
